card.name: Spanish hummingbird snowstorm abstract
card.fires_on: Small words and word endings inside one Spanish scientific abstract about a snowstorm's effect on hummingbirds and flowers. It fires on articles like el and la, verb endings, commas and digits.

modes.label: Articles and linking words
modes.description: Spanish el, la, de and podría in sentences about the effect of weather on birds.
modes.example: Aquí documentamos<< el>> efecto de una nevada sever

modes.label: Verb endings and digits
modes.description: Endings of past-tense verbs and digits in counts of birds, flowers and visits.
modes.example: Un mes después del evento climático hub<<o>> 67 registros de colibrí
